review_scope: Inspect the merged EFB-001 tree and verify the Product Owner decision baseline is present.
Verify all 19 blocking rules ADRs were resolved and trace back to v0.2 specification sections.
Check each resolved ADR for contradictions with the product pillars, turn sequence, board rules, resources, enemy intent rules and run structure.
Verify accepted rules are executable and do not rely on unrecorded assumptions.
Check the The Unlit 12-card deck and separate Hollow Crown relic decisions are preserved.
Check Fast/true-ending requirements, Overflow penalty, Fog/glyph accessibility and enemy vigor/block rules are consistent.
Check open title/trademark decision remains non-blocking and is not represented as cleared.
Inspect ADR validator source and exact-head validation artifact; confirm the run checked PR head 76d07ff80121a465371a785350f7a6a2c6c853fe.

Identify any accepted decision that conflicts with the source specification or later EFB-002 implementation. Do not silently reopen settled decisions; raise a Product Owner decision only where evidence proves a real conflict.

required_output.findings: ADR/file-specific findings with severity, source traceability, impact and recommended resolution.
required_output.evidence: Merged commit, reviewed ADR paths, validation run/artifact, reviewer identity and coverage.
required_output.acceptance: Do not PASS if a P0 rule remains ambiguous, an ADR conflicts with another accepted rule, or validation evidence is not tied to the reviewed candidate.

independence_requirement: Reviewer must be distinct from the EFB-001 Product Owner/author and record an explicit identity.
